h:
这是我目前正在使用的 ComfyUI 的工作流程，这是每个请求上传的内容，供任何希望测试、自由使用它并在此基础上构建的人使用

强烈推荐（需要）ComtyUI 管理器，因为其中集成了许多自定义节点。
从管理器菜单下载并安装缺少的节点，以使工作流程正常工作

工作流程默认设置为 25 步 Euler A 一代，并采用 Hires Fix 的 10 步相同流程。
后续的附加步骤可以用于定制或修改修复检测器中的基本图像，以使其成为具有目标更改的一致变化生成。
这是检查点加载器左侧的实验性 IPadapter 生成，用于“假 lora”生成

o.en:
This is my workflow for ComfyUI, the one I'm currently using, this is an upload per request for anyone who wishes to test, freely use it and build upon it

ComtyUI manager is highly recommended (need to have) as there are many custom nodes integrated in it.
Download and install missing nodes from manager menu to make workflow work as proper

Workflow is by default set for 25 step Euler A generation with Hires Fix of 10 steps of same process.
Additional later steps of generations are possible for customising or modifying base image in inpaint detector to make it a consistent generation of variation with targeted changes.
the is an experimental IPadapter generation at the left of checkpoint loader for "fake lora" generations
